EN: This is a restricted area. Prepare to be sliced and diced.
ZH: 这是禁区。准备好被切丁切片吧！

EN: We located the control site for all the failed experiments. Time to put an end to them once and for all.
ZH: 我们找到了所有失败实验的控制中心。是时候一劳永逸地终结它们了。

EN: Whispers in the Vault
ZH: 避难所中的低语

EN: Shut down the security mainframe
ZH: 关闭安保主机

EN: Shut down the science mainframe
ZH: 关闭科研主机

EN: Shut down the command mainframe
ZH: 关闭指挥主机

EN: End all the experiments
ZH: 终结所有实验

EN: The purple is silent! BUT IT YEEEEEELLLS!
ZH: 紫色沉默不语！可它啊啊啊尖叫！

EN: The heretic heralds the blind blanket!
ZH: 异端吹响了盲目的号角！

EN: Give it time. Give it eternity.
ZH: 给它时间。给它永恒。

EN: Easy there, unstable fellow... Purple is a color. It doesn't make sounds.
ZH: 淡定，精神不稳定的朋友……紫色是种颜色。它不会发出声音。

EN: Huh... I can hear some weird buzz. Very faint.
ZH: 呃……我能听到一阵奇怪的嗡嗡声。非常微弱。

EN: The chems. A poor ward. I know. I know.
ZH: 那些药物。糟糕的守卫。我知道。我知道。

EN: No. No. Psycho. Psycho helps. But you need to hurt.
ZH: 不。不。狂暴药。狂暴药有用。但你必须承受痛苦。

EN: So you pumped yourself full of what? Mentats?
ZH: 所以你往自己身体里灌的是什么？曼他特？

EN: Multiple mainframes to shut down! Got it!
ZH: 多台主机要关闭！明白了！

EN: The mainframes. They connect everything. Everyone. All the sites…
ZH: 这些主机。它们连接着一切。所有人。所有地点……

EN: There is a mainframe access here. A quick hack should get us in.
ZH: 这里有主机的接口。快速破解一下就能进去。

EN: <Shut down all automated experiments>
ZH: <关闭所有自动化实验>

EN: It looks like we shut down this site and every other labs connected to it.
ZH: 看来我们关闭了这个地点以及所有相连的实验室。

EN: Do you whisper to the wire? Taste the zap?
ZH: 你在对电线低语吗？想尝尝电击的滋味？

EN: You must not. Only one can remain.
ZH: 你不能。只有一人能留下。

EN: You are not the one.
ZH: 你不是那个天选之人。

EN: Yes. Yes. The mainf…. Noooo you made it angry!
ZH: 是。是。主机……不，你把它惹火了！

EN: My headache is growing. I can almost understand you.
ZH: 我的头疼越来越厉害了。我几乎能听懂你在说什么。

EN: Err… let me try this. But the sun of reason makes you whole again.
ZH: 呃……让我试试。理性的阳光会让你重获完整。

EN: We are here to help. We are looking for ways to shut down what ails you.
ZH: 我们是来帮忙的。我们在想办法关闭让你受苦的东西。

EN: One of the mainframes! Let's get password cracking!
ZH: 其中一台主机！让我们来破解密码！

EN: <Activate internal security purge mode>
ZH: <激活内部安全清除模式>

EN: It should take effect the next time the system updates. Hope we get out in time.
ZH: 应该在下一次系统更新时生效。希望我们来得及撤离。

EN: The stash… The voice says no. Want it?
ZH: 那批物资……那声音说不。想要吗？

EN: Then no stash. No fun.
ZH: 那就不给物资。没意思。

EN: Yes.
ZH: 想。

EN: If the voice says no…
ZH: 既然声音说不……

EN: No, I want the other thing.
ZH: 不，我要另一样东西。

EN: This mainframe. It looks important. And noisy.
ZH: 这台主机。看起来很重要。而且噪音很大。

EN: <Seal all sites permanently>
ZH: <永久封锁所有地点>

EN: Only after we are out, right? RIGHT? Here goes nothing...
ZH: 得在我们离开之后，对吧？对吧？豁出去了……

EN: I feel... off. A faint screech hums at the edge of my mind.
ZH: 我觉得……有点不对劲。一种微弱的尖叫在我脑海边缘嗡鸣。

EN: It's like a drain on my sanity.
ZH: 这简直是在榨干我的理智。

EN: The Leftovers
ZH: 遗留者

EN: Raaahaaaa!
ZH: 啊啊啊！

EN: Uuuuuuuuuuuurgh!
ZH: 呃呃呃——！

EN: Oooooooog!
ZH: 嗷嗷嗷！

EN: Priiiiiiiiiii!
ZH: 吱吱吱！

EN: The Strip is under siege by Deathclaws. Civilians are trapped and in need of a hero.
ZH: 新维加斯大道遭到死爪围攻。平民被困，急需一位英雄。

EN: Who needs saving?
ZH: 谁需要拯救？

EN: Rescue a familiar face
ZH: 拯救一位熟人

EN: Silence the humming Deathclaw
ZH: 让那只哼歌的死爪安静下来

EN: Be a hero: save the people of The Strip from Deathclaws.
ZH: 当一回英雄：把新维加斯大道的人们从死爪手中拯救出来。

EN: Can I pet them claws?
ZH: 我能摸摸那爪子吗？

EN: Heeeeelp!
Yeaaaaah!
Then, I can pet 'em, right?
ZH: 那我就能摸了，对吧？

EN: You're in shock, you need help!
ZH: 你受惊了，需要帮助！

EN: You sure can! One just so happen to be waiting for your touch outside!
ZH: 当然可以！正好有一只在外面等着你来摸呢！

EN: We are here to put them down, so… no.
ZH: 我们是来放倒它们的，所以……不行。

EN: <Louder> CAN I PET THEM CLAWS?
ZH: <更大声地> 我能摸摸那爪子吗？

EN: Thanks for saving me. I have a locker in one of the rooms. The contents are yours. Code is 1337.
ZH: 谢谢你们救了我。我在某间房里有个储物柜。里面的东西归你们了。密码是1337。

EN: I'll take a note, thanks!
ZH: 我记下了，谢谢！

EN: Don't care 'bout 'em Deathclaws. I ain't leaving.
ZH: 我才不管那些死爪呢。我是不走的。

EN: You bet I will sign the… Hey, wait a minute! Nice try.
ZH: 当然，我会签那……嘿，等一下！想得美。

EN: Well, I never…
ZH: 哼，真是岂有此理……

EN: That sure is your right! You just have to go sign the discharge with the officer outside.
ZH: 那确实是你的权利！你只要去外面跟军官签个离职文件就行。

EN: We're sanitizing the whole place with fire so... your call.
ZH: 我们要用火把整个地方消毒一遍，所以……随你便。

EN: Here's the locker that other guy told us about. What's the code again?
ZH: 这就是那人说的储物柜。密码是多少来着？

EN: Ah, that ain't it. Oh well, I should have written it down
ZH: 啊，不对。哎，我该写下来的。

EN: Got it! Let's see what we have here.
ZH: 打开了！看看里面有什么。

EN: Ah, shoot. That ruined some of the content, but at least it's open!
ZH: 哎，该死。弄坏了一些东西，但好歹打开了！

EN: <Bash it open>
ZH: <砸开它>

EN: Hummmmadummmmdummm
ZH: 哼～嗯～哒嗯～嗯～

EN: Wait, is that Deathclaw humming? It gives off real boss vibes!
ZH: 等等，那只死爪在哼歌？它真有一股老大范儿！

EN: What are you doing here, Sweet Peach? Don't you know the place is crawling with Deathclaws?
ZH: 你在这儿干什么，甜桃？你不知道这地方爬满了死爪吗？

EN: Ah, Pumpkin, do I look like I need saving?
ZH: 啊，小南瓜，你看我像需要拯救的吗？

EN: Well, hurrah for me, I guess. Would you like a little kiss on the cheek with that?
ZH: 嗯，那可真该为我欢呼了。要不要顺便在你脸上亲一口？

EN: Of course we do, and we came here to save you.
ZH: 当然啦，我们就是来救你的。

EN: We killed the Deathclaws. You're welcome!
ZH: 我们干掉了那些死爪。不用谢！

EN: Attend the Town Hall on The Strip to discuss defense strategy and secure allies.
ZH: 出席新维加斯大道的市政厅会议，讨论防御策略并争取盟友。

EN: Town Hall
ZH: 市政厅

EN: Attend the gathering
ZH: 出席集会

EN: Secure Securitrons support
ZH: 争取保安机器人的支持

EN: Attend the Town Hall on The Strip.
ZH: 出席新维加斯大道的市政厅会议。

EN: Much obliged.
ZH: 非常感谢。

EN: Welcome to the Town Hall!
ZH: 欢迎来到市政厅！

EN: If you're looking for the meeting, take the elevator up.
ZH: 要是你找会场的话，坐电梯上楼。

EN: Hey, if, like the others, you're here for my world-famous Deathclaw poison, forget it.
ZH: 嘿，要是你和别人一样，是来要我的世界著名死爪毒药的，那就免谈。

EN: Hey, I'm a poisoner, not a miracle worker.
ZH: 嘿，我是制毒师，不是创造奇迹的人。

EN: Nah, I decided to work on bio-engineering furry roaches instead.
ZH: 不，我改主意了，决定去搞毛茸茸蟑螂的生物工程。

EN: <Eye roll> Next you'll tell me you can wrestle one barehanded...
ZH: <翻个白眼> 接下来你是不是要说你能赤手空拳摔一只？……

EN: So you just gave up?
ZH: 所以你就放弃了？

EN: Don't stop at the first hurdle! Keep at it!
ZH: 别遇到第一个坎就停下！继续干！

EN: Whatever. They ain't resisting bullets, I'll tell you that.
ZH: 随你吧。反正它们挡不住子弹，这点我可以告诉你。

EN: The Deathclaws have developed a resistance.
ZH: 死爪已经产生了抗性。

EN: Hey, what's this tucked away in the corner? An Enclave uniform!
ZH: 嘿，角落里藏着什么？一件英克雷制服！

EN: An Enclave uniform? Hmm… that's suspicious.
ZH: 英克雷制服？嗯……真可疑。

EN: Hey! You! Psst! I can help with the Deathclaws. I need a sample of their DNA though. Can you arrange that?
ZH: 嘿！喂！嘘！我能帮忙对付死爪。但我需要它们的DNA样本。你能弄到吗？

EN: I'm obviously not talking to the right people. Move along.
ZH: 很显然，我找错人了。走开。

EN: The Enclave is everywhere. Oops. And now I must ensure your silence.
ZH: 英克雷无处不在。哎呀。现在，我得让你永远闭嘴了。

EN: Mission compromised. Leave no witnesses.
ZH: 任务暴露。不留活口。

EN: What the heck is NDA?
ZH: NDA到底是个什么鬼？

EN: You don't look like you're from around here.
ZH: 你看起来不像是本地人。

EN: We found an Enclave uniform earlier. Yours?
ZH: 我们刚才捡到一件英克雷制服。你的？

EN: Deathclaws everywhere, and no Ma June to make me her famous Omelet...
ZH: 到处是死爪，却没人能做玛·琼那道拿手煎蛋卷……

EN: A gastronome after my own heart! Here's something to help your hunt.
ZH: 真是懂吃的同道中人！这个能帮你觅食。

EN: Where you find one, chances are you'll find the other. Take this. It'll get you in the mood.
ZH: 找到一个，多半就能找到另一个。拿着这个。能让你进入状态。

EN: Deathclaw eggs are hard to come by, but I too would like a taste.
ZH: 死爪蛋难得一见，不过我也想来一口。

EN: I find 'em rubbery and foul. Me like the steak better.
ZH: 我觉得那玩意儿口感像橡胶一样又腥又难吃。我还是更喜欢死爪肉排。

EN: Oh, didn't see you there!
ZH: 哦，没看见你在这儿！

EN: For the last time, your mother is a hag, and I don't want her in our home.
ZH: 我最后再说一遍，你妈就是个巫婆，我才不要她住进我们家里来。

EN: That's right. Mind your own business and pitter-patter out of here.
ZH: 没错。少管闲事，赶紧从这儿溜走吧。

EN: Don't talk trash about her mom, I'll smack you.
ZH: 别说她妈妈的坏话，不然我揍你。

EN: This!
ZH: 这个！

EN: <say nothing>
ZH: <什么也不说>

EN: In-laws, am I right?
ZH: 亲戚之间那点破事，对吧？

EN: What happened to the ex?
ZH: 前夫后来怎么了？

EN: Don't look at me with knives in your eyes. I know what happened to your ex-husband!
ZH: 别用刀一般的眼神瞪我。我知道你前夫出了什么事！

EN: Ah! Nosy Rosy is here!
ZH: 啊！爱管闲事的罗西来了！

EN: Hear me. We need more help, or the Deathclaws will destroy New Vegas.
ZH: 听我说。我们需要更多帮助，否则死爪会毁掉新维加斯。

EN: Then this will help you. We'll keep in touch.
ZH: 那这个能帮上你。我们保持联系。

EN: You are jesting, I'm sure? No? What if we pay you like… a lot?
ZH: 你是在开玩笑吧？不是？那如果我们付你很多钱呢？

EN: How about we send a couple of our finest combat-ready pets. Keep them alive, will you?
ZH: 派几只我们最精锐的战斗宠物去怎么样？可千万别让它们送命了，好吗？

EN: We are here to help. Recruiting allies and stocking up on weapons.
ZH: 我们是来帮忙的。招募盟友，囤积武器。

EN: You are on your own. We just came here to watch you fail.
ZH: 你们自求多福吧。我们只是来看你们怎么惨败的。

EN: We'll fight them off, but not alone. You, too, are capable.
ZH: 我们会击退它们，但不是孤军奋战。你们也有能力。

EN: I know some of you just want to pack up and leave, but that ain't the way.
ZH: 我知道你们有些人只想收拾东西走人，但那样可不行。

EN: We need to stick together and mount a defense.
ZH: 我们必须团结起来，组织防御。

EN: Ah! Vault Dwellers! The capable kind. Welcome!
ZH: 啊！避难所居民！还是身手不凡的那种。欢迎欢迎！

EN: Ah, crawled out of your vault? Here to ask for my Securitrons, like the so-called “leaders” of the Strip?
ZH: 啊，从你们的避难所里爬出来了？像新维加斯大道那些所谓的“领袖”一样，来找我要保安机器人？

EN: This weapon might come in handy. You should also seek a Ghoul who calls himself The King. He is useful.
ZH: 这把武器或许派得上用场。你还应该去找一位自称为“猫王”的尸鬼。他很有用。

EN: Another sycophant! Then The King will adore you. You should seek his help too. And take this for your trouble.
ZH: 又是一个阿谀奉承之辈！那“猫王”肯定会很喜欢你的。你也该去向他求援。拿着这个吧，算作你的辛苦费。

EN: Glad to hear. Anything else you can help with?
ZH: 很高兴听你这么说。你还能帮上别的忙吗？

EN: Mr. House! What an honor to meet you!
ZH: 豪斯先生！见到你真是荣幸！

EN: Of course they'll help. This is my home too.
ZH: 它们当然会出力。毕竟这里也是我的家园。

EN: Wrong place, scoundrels! This room is off limit.
ZH: 来错地方了，恶棍！这房间是禁区。

EN: The King is a major player on The Strip. He can tip the scales against the Deathclaws.
ZH: “猫王”是新维加斯大道上的重要人物。他能扭转对抗死爪的战局。

EN: Pleading to the King
ZH: 恳请猫王

EN: Ask the King for help
ZH: 向猫王求助

EN: We need to enlist the King to fight against Deathclaws.
ZH: 我们需要争取猫王的力量来共同对抗死爪。

EN: I'm so excited to join the King Impersonator School! Do you think he'll welcome me?
ZH: 能加入猫王模仿者学校我太兴奋了！你觉得他会接纳我吗？

EN: My hair is perfect, you meanie... <sob>
ZH: 我的头发完美极了，你这坏蛋……<抽泣>

EN: That's the third fee I've been asked to pay. How many more are there?
ZH: 这已经是我被要求交的第三笔报名费了。到底还有多少笔啊？

EN: I make my own pomade out of Wonderglue. Here. Try for yourself.
ZH: 我自己用万能胶做发油。给。你试试看。

EN: They love greasy hair, but dude, not that greasy!
ZH: 他们确实喜欢油头，但老兄，也不至于油成这样吧！

EN: Sure will. Just so happens I'm here to collect the registration fees.
ZH: 当然会。正好我是来收报名费的。

EN: Well met, fellow hopeful! We're here for the same reason. Any tip?
ZH: 幸会，同行追梦人！我们目标一致。有啥建议吗？

EN: Remember, every man should aspire to be a king in their own right.
ZH: 记住，每个男人都该立志凭自身本事成为王者。

EN: I'm the boss of my own destiny, you bet! But you must mean The King! He's up top!
ZH: 我当然是我自己命运的主宰！不过你找的一定是猫王本尊吧！他在最顶楼！

EN: That's the spirit! You'll have to meet The King first. Higher floor.
ZH: 要的就是这股劲！你得先去见见猫王，在楼上。

EN: Easily solved. Also, go ask the King for permission, up a couple of floors.
ZH: 这好办。另外，上几层楼去征求猫王的同意吧。

EN: Are you the boss?
ZH: 你是老板吗？

EN: Uh-huh-huh, yeah!
ZH: 呃哼哼，是啊！

EN: I lack the proper attire.
ZH: 我缺身像样的行头。

EN: Ah, newcomers! Here to join the lesson?
ZH: 啊，新来的！来上我的课？

EN: I hate this place. I want out! I want out! I want ourrrrrrrrrgh!
ZH: 我恨这个地方。我要出去！我要出去！我要出……呃啊啊啊啊啊！

EN: Ah! A Vault Dweller! A rare sight! And yes, I'm the King.
ZH: 啊！避难所居民！真是稀客！没错，我就是猫王。

EN: Ah! That's something the King can respect, but you won't refuse this boon, will ya?
ZH: 啊！这值得猫王的敬重，但你总不会拒绝这份赏赐吧？

EN: But of course! Are your pockets deep enough?
ZH: 当然！你的腰包够鼓吗？

EN: Then the King grants your request with glee. You'll need this.
ZH: 那么猫王欣然恩准你的请求。你会需要这个的。

EN: I'm certain I've got a six-pack somewhere. Don't drink it all in one sitting!
ZH: 我肯定在哪儿藏了六连包。可别一口气全喝光了！

EN: Knowing you'll fight alongside us is it's own reward.
ZH: 知道你会与我们并肩作战，本身就是一种回报。

EN: Caps are always good.
ZH: 瓶盖永远不嫌多。

EN: I'd like to officially join the Kings.
ZH: 我想正式加入猫王帮。

EN: We do a lot of travelling. Makes one thirsty. Any Nuka Cola Quantum around?
ZH: 我们经常赶路。容易口渴。有量子核子可乐吗？

EN: I heard you're helping with the Deathclaw problem.
ZH: 我听说你们在帮忙解决死爪的问题。

EN: You inspired me to rally my boys and join the fight.
ZH: 受你们鼓舞，我集结了兄弟们参战。

EN: And for your part, The King would like to grant you a favor!
ZH: 为了感谢你的付出，猫王愿满足你一个心愿！

EN: Our efforts have paid off. The last remaining Deathclaws and their Alpha have been cornered in a cave.
ZH: 我们的努力有了回报。最后剩下的死爪和它们的首领阿尔法被逼进了一个山洞。

EN: Omega that Alpha!
ZH: 终结那个阿尔法！

EN: Defeat the Alpha Deathclaw
ZH: 击败领头死爪

EN: Loot the Alpha's stash
ZH: 搜刮阿尔法的存货

EN: We have trapped the Alpha Deathclaw. Time to end the threat.
ZH: 我们已经困住了领头死爪。是时候终结这个威胁了。

EN: Aw, man! Stop the violence! Deathclaws are just one of Earth's precious babies
ZH: 哎呀，老兄！住手吧！死爪也是地球珍贵的宝贝生灵啊。

EN: That's not a loving attitude.
ZH: 那可不是有爱的态度。

EN: You're brutes. But we came prepared.
ZH: 你们是暴徒。但我们早有准备。

EN: See? You get it. So you'll go in and help them, right? RIGHT?
ZH: 瞧？你懂我的意思。所以你会进去帮它们，对吧？对吧？

EN: I have half a mind to let them gnaw on your bones. Get out of here, idiot!
ZH: 我有点想让它们啃你的骨头。滚出这里，蠢货！

EN: You're in my way. So I will remove you.
ZH: 你挡了我的路。所以我得除掉你。

EN: Maybe you're onto something. I met a talking Deathclaw once.
ZH: 也许你有点道理。我碰到过一只会说话的死爪。
